caption:
Nobody on your team should have to remember to ask for a review.

Here is the exact sequence:

Job marked complete → SMS with a direct review link goes out in minutes.

No response → a follow-up email fires two days later.

Every send and result logs against that customer's record.

This is an example workflow, illustrative and not a specific client account. It's the same review engine built into the Black Arrow platform.

See it live on your own pipeline, 14 days free, no card.
